title: When the Language Wakes
author: Wren Eriksen
blurb: Casper Hartwell, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
